channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Domantas Sabonis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Domantas Sabonis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Linas Kleiza on Jonas Valanciunas, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
During conversations, Kleiza wondered if he had made a mistake by not going to the United States earlier to meet the country's stars.

“Maybe I should have told Jonas (Valanciunas) and Domantas (Sabonis) earlier how important they were. It seemed to me that it was obvious that this team was theirs. Maybe that was my mistake,”

Linas Kleiza on Jonas Valanciunas, Domantas Sabonis, Apr 8, 2025. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Doug Christie on DeMar DeRozan, Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Kings interim head coach Doug Christie:

“Part of my job is to get the heck out of the way and let (Fox, Sabonis, DeRozan) do what they do.”

Doug Christie on DeMar DeRozan, Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox, Dec 30, 2024. Source: Twitter @MattGeorgeSAC.

item.title: LeBron James on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
“He could change them, and they might have the kind assets to make a trade work. They have a lot of young talent, and because they’re a small market, they haven’t spent like drunken sailors. They have some draft picks a young talent. If they could get to the salary, LeBron would take (De’Aron) Fox and (Domantas) Sabonis and elevate the hell out of them — particularly Fox. With that threesome, those guys could be a force.”

LeBron James on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox, Dec 12, 2024. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Nikola Jokic, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
“I'm not saying Domantas Sabonis is better than Nikola Jokic or anything like that,”

Mike Brown on Nikola Jokic, Domantas Sabonis, Dec 12, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Anthony Davis on Domantas Sabonis’ 9-0 record against him in his career:

“I’m all about the team … the 1-on-1 thing, it doesn’t bother me”

Anthony Davis on Domantas Sabonis, Mar 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Malik Monk on Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Monk said of his performance.

“Somebody besides Domantas (Sabonis) and Keegan (Murray) was going to have to step up. I think me and Davion (Mitchell) did that, especially with the second unit. Trey (Lyles) had some big plays. But yeah man, I just knew I had to get it going at some point and I was getting to the lane and midrange and the flow opened things up for me.”

Malik Monk on Domantas Sabonis, Mar 2, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Draymond Green on Domantas Sabonis, Trae Young
item.description:
“The Kings are currently at fifth in the West and have been in the top four most of the year, which means [they’re] very much in the playoffs, right there next to home-court advantage in the first round. But they’re in fifth. [Fox’s averaging] 27 and five. Domantas Sabonis is averaging 19.9 points -- so we’re just going to give him 20 -- 13 rebounds and eight assists, and the Kings are in fifth place. “Now that’s interesting because in a stat-driven league, we have the tale of two tapes which is one team right on the brink of the playoffs, another team that is firmly in the playoff picture right now, all three [including Trae Young] with incredible stats, none make the All-Star Game.”

Draymond Green on Domantas Sabonis, Trae Young, Feb 6, 2024. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Mike Brown on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Kings coach Mike Brown told Andscape.

“They are playing at an unbelievably elite level, Domantas establishing historic numbers with his double-doubles and De’Aaron setting a new career mark for 3-point field goals. Every year, there are deserving players left off the team but, to me, this is truly a glaring wrongdoing.”

Mike Brown on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox, Feb 1, 2024. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Myles Turner on Domantas Sabonis, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
“Those days when I was playing the four (alongside Sabonis before Haliburton’s arrival), those were dark days for me because I wasn’t happy,”

Myles Turner on Domantas Sabonis, Tyrese Haliburton, Dec 8, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Mike Brown on Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Mike Brown:

“Sabonis is one of the hardest-working guys I’ve been around. He struggled a little bit with the playoffs last year. He worked on things that people thought were his weakness and forced him to go in the playoffs and at times during the regular season. You’re going to see him have a lot more counters to the things that our opponents take away. I also believe the confidence and his ability to shoot the ball from range has gone up. So you may see more of that as well.”

Mike Brown on Domantas Sabonis, Oct 6, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Davion Mitchell on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox, Mike Brown
item.description:
Jason Anderson:Davion Mitchell on Kings coach Mike Brown:

“He held everyone accountable no matter who it was. I think he got on Fox and Sabonis more than anyone.”

Davion Mitchell on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox, Mike Brown, May 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
“It wasn't like (Sabonis) didn't get off without any punishment, but we didn't think that rose to the level of excessive and over-the-top, conduct detrimental and repeat offender. That's why you separate those two and deal with one act on the court -- and then another act.”

Joe Dumars on Domantas Sabonis, Apr 19, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: LeBron James on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
LeBron James on De’Aaron Fox and Domantas Sabonis:

“They complement each other very well. I think Sabonis’ ability to play at the elbow like his father used to do, his ability to pass, his ability to rebound and score makes him very dynamic.”

LeBron James on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox, Dec 22, 2022. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: Sasha Vujacic on Vlade Divac, Drazen Petrovic, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Vujacic told ClutchPoints.

“And for me, being European coming from Europe, I understand what the journey was to get here. And when these kids back in the day saw what Vlade [Divac], Drazen [Petrovic], [Arvydas] Sabonis, all the pioneers did — without naming everybody — and then what different generations did, they got excited and they understood that hard work will pay off.”

Sasha Vujacic on Vlade Divac, Drazen Petrovic, Domantas Sabonis, Sep 16, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Jason Anderson:Alvin Gentry on Domantas Sabonis:

“He’s out for personal reasons. It’s not any big deal. I think he’ll be back soon.”

Alvin Gentry on Domantas Sabonis, Mar 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Monte McNair on De'Aaron Fox, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Jason Anderson:Monte McNair on Fox/Sabonis:

“We think his skillset complements De’Aaron. De’Aaron’s skillset complements him. And Domas’ skillset complements just about everybody. He might have been able to get me some open shots out there, so we’re excited to see those two guys together.”

Monte McNair on De'Aaron Fox, Domantas Sabonis, Feb 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Domantas Sabonis, Myles Turner
item.description:
Pritchard on Turner and Sabonis:

“I think the guys wanted to work, but it just was a little clunky at times … I thought, if there’s an opportunity to maybe let one stand up and leave and one to get to another place and have his opportunity, that we would look at it.”

Kevin Pritchard on Domantas Sabonis, Myles Turner, Feb 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @RomeovilleKid.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Lance Stephenson, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
James Boyd:Rick Carlisle:

“Tremendous effort by our guys. ... Sabonis was spectacular. Stephenson was tremendous. ... Lance has given us a different vibe as a team. The spark he provides, the personality. ... There's a change in our team.”

Rick Carlisle on Lance Stephenson, Domantas Sabonis, Jan 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @RomeovilleKid.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Domantas Sabonis, Myles Turner
item.description:
Scott Agness:Carlisle on Sabonis-Turner pairing:

“I do believe these guys can play effectively together, but I also believe there may be a formula that may be different than today’s formula of 5-out.”

Rick Carlisle on Domantas Sabonis, Myles Turner, Sep 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Domantas Sabonis, Myles Turner
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Carlisle on Sabonis/Turner combo:

“I think there's ways we can stagger them in the lineup with the rotation so they can play together some but 1 play w/o the other.”

Rick Carlisle on Domantas Sabonis, Myles Turner, Jun 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate Bjorkgren on Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Tony East:Bjorkgren on Sabonis not being named an All-Star:

“I was disappointed. He is an All-Star, and very very deserving to be on that team... Domas deserved to be on that team.”

Nate Bjorkgren on Domantas Sabonis, Feb 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @TEastNBA.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder on the Jazz's effort:

“That’s when your defense has to carry you. We had some excellent individual performances — Royce on Brogdon, Rudy on Sabonis. … And our work on the boards was important tonight — those extra possessions were critical.”

Quin Snyder on Domantas Sabonis, Feb 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Nate Bjorkgren on Domantas Sabonis, Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Bjorkgren on heavy minutes for Sabonis/Brogdon:

“I like the minutes right where they are. It's important how I manage them when we don't play.... Our management of them has been smart. Knowing how long to practice, knowing when to practice.”

Nate Bjorkgren on Domantas Sabonis, Malcolm Brogdon, Jan 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Kevin Pritchard on Sabonis:

“Domas looks good and we expect him in full in camp. … He says he feels great.”

Kevin Pritchard on Domantas Sabonis, Nov 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Myles Turner on Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Turner on if he expects Sabonis to be back:

“I'm playing with the mentality he won't be back. I'm preparing for the worst.”

Myles Turner on Domantas Sabonis, Jul 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:McMillan on Sabonis again:

“We do know what it is. We're hopeful that he will return and be able to play with us the remainder of this season”

Nate McMillan on Domantas Sabonis, Jul 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
“Here’s what happened: When Victor was in [OKC’s offer] and they said, ‘Okay fine, we’ll put Sabonis in too,’ in my mind, the deal was done,”

Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo, Domantas Sabonis, Jan 25, 2020. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
“When I heard Domantas’ name along with Victor’s name, I felt like that was enough. You can be really, really greedy in this business. But I felt like Sam [Presti] made a really honest, good offer and it was what I wanted to hear. I felt good about it.”

Kevin Pritchard on Victor Oladipo, Domantas Sabonis, Jan 25, 2020. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Kevin Pritchard:

“We love the toughness that Domantas brings to our team, and we can't wait to see him play in his expanded role this year. He’s had so much growth in his career; and we're excited for what that means for his future, as well as the future of our team”

Kevin Pritchard on Domantas Sabonis, Oct 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Arvydas Sabonis on Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Arvydas Sabonis on Domantas Sabonis season in Indiana:

“He had a nice season. He still lacks confidence from mid range, but I like his effort. As soon as he will fix his mid range shooting, everything will be fine. I hope we will help him with this in National Team this summer.”

Arvydas Sabonis on Domantas Sabonis, Apr 23, 2019. Source: Twitter @Urbodo.
